Definition: properly, dripping; hence, fresh (i.e. recently made such)
BiblicalUsage: The word is fresh, new, just made. Samson found a new jawbone of an ass and slew a thousand men with it, and Isaiah speaks of wounds left open and unbound, fresh and untreated.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a fresh jawbone in Samson's hand and fresh wounds on a nation both show how quickly things turn.
